_comment: Template registry. Copy to the workspace root as .gws-accounts.json and edit.
The real file is gitignored because it maps aliases to real email addresses.
credential_file    where gws-auth-setup.sh writes the exported refresh token
client_secret_file the Desktop OAuth client JSON downloaded from GCP console
project_id         the GCP project that owns the OAuth client. Sent as
x-goog-user-project. Must be the project ID, not the name.
scopes             'workspace-no-cloud' or omitted. See the note below.
projects           child project dirs this alias serves, used by
ABOUT scopes: omit it and the account is granted cloud-platform along with
the Workspace scopes, which is the historical default and is correct for a
domain you administer. Set it to 'workspace-no-cloud' for any account on a
Workspace domain you do NOT administer, such as an employer's. Carrying a
Google Cloud scope subjects the token to Google Cloud session control's
reauth clock (roughly 16h), which surfaces as invalid_rapt, and turning that
policy off requires super-admin. See RUNBOOK.md.

personal.description: Consumer Gmail. External consent screen, Publish App.

work.description: Workspace domain you do NOT administer. Internal consent screen.
